title: River Development Agent Manifest Package Execution Request Composition Foundation
objective: Establish the deterministic governed composition boundary that consumes a successfully propagated implementation manifest and composes the existing package execution request contract without executing the package, acquiring new authority, bypassing production execution authority, or duplicating existing execution boundaries.

include: Define the manifest package execution request composition input contract.
Consume the successful DEV-326 manifest propagation result as the manifest-side source of truth.
Compose the existing RiverDevPackageExecutionRequest contract from explicitly authorized and propagated inputs.
Preserve manifest identity and propagated manifest data required by the existing package execution boundary.
Preserve the requested execution mode and existing authorization-related inputs without creating or escalating authority.
Reject or block composition when manifest propagation is not successful or required package execution request inputs are absent or invalid.
Produce deterministic composition results for equivalent inputs.
Add focused tests for successful composition, blocked composition, malformed inputs, authority preservation, manifest preservation, and determinism.
exclude: Creating, acquiring, consuming, or escalating production execution authority.
Changing DEV-323 production execution authority semantics.
Performing repository writes other than the DEV-327 implementation itself.
Committing, pushing, merging, or deploying as part of the implementation engine.

invariants: Composition must never itself execute a package.
Composition must never create or escalate execution authority.
A manifest that has not successfully passed the DEV-326 propagation boundary must not become executable package input.
The existing RiverDevPackageExecutionRequest remains the downstream package executor contract.
Existing production execution authority boundaries remain authoritative.
Equivalent valid inputs must produce deterministic equivalent composition results.
Blocked composition must expose an explicit deterministic blocked reason.
No hidden fallback may manufacture missing manifest or execution authority data.
verification: Run the focused DEV-327 test file.
Run the full River Development Agent test suite.
Verify exact working-tree scope before staging.
Review the complete diff before commit.
